LanguageData.TKUtils.Letters.Passion.Title: Passion
LanguageData.TKUtils.Letters.Passion.Failed.Body: After some deep soul-searching, {ViewerName} couldn't deepen their passion in {SkillName}.
LanguageData.TKUtils.Letters.Passion.Decrease.Body: After some deep-soul searching, {ViewerName} discovered they hated their job in {SkillName}, and became less passionate about it as a result.
LanguageData.TKUtils.Letters.Passion.Increase.Body: After working on {SkillName}, {ViewerName} discovered a new way of doing things that allowed their passion to deepen.
LanguageData.TKUtils.Letters.Passion.Shuffle.Body: After {ViewerName}'s soul was returned to them from a hungry wraith, they discovered their passions have been dramatically altered.
